summary: The Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP) pays full tuition, SEK 12,000 a month, a travel grant and insurance for a one- or two-year master's in Sweden. It is for working professionals from eligible countries (Nigeria has been on the list) with leadership experience. Winners combine good grades, at least 3,000 hours of paid work, real leadership, and a clear plan to contribute to sustainable development.
lookfor: Professional experience (minimum 3,000 hours of paid work)
Leadership experience, shown with concrete results
Potential to contribute to sustainable development in your home country or region
Commitment to the SI Network for Global Professionals
cycle: Two stages. Stage 1: apply to SI-eligible master's programmes on universityadmissions.se (opens around 16 October 2026, closes 15 January 2027). Stage 2: the SI scholarship portal is expected to open for about two weeks in February 2027 (last cycle: 9–25 February). Results are expected in April 2027. Check the SI page for the exact 2027 dates.

eligibility.q: Are you a citizen of a country on SI's current eligible list?
eligibility.no: Check the list on the SI page each year. If your country is missing, consider the KTH Scholarship, Erasmus Mundus or DAAD EPOS.

eligibility.q: Will you have at least 3,000 hours of paid work experience by the SI deadline?
eligibility.no: That is about 20 months of full-time work. Keep working and apply in a later round.

eligibility.q: Do you have leadership experience you can prove (leading a team, project, organisation or initiative)?
eligibility.no: Take on a leadership role at work or in your community now; you will need someone to verify it.

eligibility.q: Will you apply on universityadmissions.se by 15 January 2027 to at least one SI-eligible programme and be a fee-paying student?
eligibility.no: Without that application you cannot apply to SI. Use SI's list of eligible programmes.

eligibility.q: Do you have no previous Swedish degree and have not lived in Sweden long-term?
eligibility.no: Check the SI guidance — these applicants are usually excluded.

steps.title: Read the SI rules and check your hours
steps.why: Most rejections are for missing eligibility, especially work hours and leadership proof.
do: Open the SI Global Professionals page and the SI FAQ.
Confirm your country is on the current eligible list.
List every paid job since graduation with dates and weekly hours; add them up (1 full-time year is roughly 1,600–1,800 hours).
Write down two or three leadership roles and who can verify each.
tips: SI's FAQ explains how to calculate hours — use its method, not your own guess.
avoid: Counting unpaid volunteering as paid work hours.
check: I have 3,000+ paid hours and at least one verifiable leadership role.

links.t: SI FAQ – scholarships for master's studies

steps.title: Choose SI-eligible master's programmes
steps.why: Only programmes on SI's list qualify, and you must be admitted to one.
do: Open SI's list of eligible programmes for 2027/28 (published in the autumn on the SI page).
Pick programmes linked to your work experience and sustainable development.
On each programme page, note entry requirements, documents (CV, letter of motivation, summary sheet) and English level.
Choose up to four programmes on universityadmissions.se, ranking the best fit first.
tips: Pick at least one programme where you are very likely to be admitted — no admission means no scholarship.
check: My ranked list includes SI-eligible programmes only.

links.t: University Admissions in Sweden – apply to master's

steps.title: Build your two-stage timeline
steps.why: Missing the January university deadline ends your SI chances for the year.
do: Mark 15 January 2027 (university application) and 1 February 2027 (document deadline at many universities).
Mark February 2027 for the SI portal window; set an alert to check the SI page in January.
Plan employer forms and reference letters for December–January.
Put weekly writing time in your calendar.
tips: The SI window is short (about two weeks). Have everything ready before it opens.
avoid: Starting SI documents only when the portal opens.
check: All key dates are in my calendar.

steps.title: Submit university application documents
steps.why: Admission to an eligible programme is a condition for the scholarship.
do: Create an account on universityadmissions.se once the application opens (around 16 October 2026).
Add your programmes and pay the application fee (SEK 900 for non-EU applicants).
Upload passport data page, degree certificate and transcripts.
Nigerian applicants: after your application is active, ask your university to email your official transcript from its official domain to verifications@uhr.se.
Upload English proof; check the Nigeria page — a fully documented four-year Nigerian bachelor's may satisfy English.
Upload programme-specific documents (CV, letter of motivation) by the document deadline.
tips: Names and birthdate must be identical on all documents and your account.
avoid: Asking for transcripts to be sent before your application is active, or sending student copies.
check: All documents show 'received' or are uploaded before the deadline.

steps.title: Get proof of work and leadership experience
steps.why: SI checks hours and leadership through its own template, signed by employers.
do: Download the current 'Proof of Work and Leadership Experience' template from the SI page when it is published.
Fill in dates, hours and duties for each employer (SI limits the number of employers — check the template).
Ask each employer to sign and stamp it.
Describe your leadership role and get it verified as the template asks.
tips: Do not use an old year's template — SI changes forms between cycles.
avoid: Hours that do not add up to 3,000 or forms without signatures.
check: My signed forms prove 3,000+ hours and leadership.

steps.title: Prepare your CV in the SI template
steps.why: SI uses its own CV format so assessors can compare applicants quickly.
do: Download SI's CV template for the current call.
Fill education, work, leadership and volunteer roles with dates.
For each leadership role, add one line of result (people led, money raised, outcome).
Save as PDF.
tips: Keep dates identical to your work proof forms.
avoid: Uploading your normal CV instead of the template.
check: My CV is in the SI template and matches my proofs.

steps.title: Write your motivation letter on leadership and impact
steps.why: It is the main place SI judges your leadership and your potential to contribute to sustainable development.
do: Read the motivation letter template and questions in the current SI call; copy them into your draft.
Leadership: give one or two specific stories — the challenge, what you did, the measurable result.
Impact: name the development problem in your country or region you will work on.
Explain how your chosen Swedish programme gives you skills for that.
Say how you will use the SI Network for Global Professionals after study.
Cut to the limit and proofread.
tips: Use numbers: 'I led 8 staff to cut water losses by 15%'.
avoid: Listing job titles without showing what you did as a leader.
Copying your university letter of motivation unchanged.
check: Each question is answered with a concrete example.

steps.prompt: Your leadership experience, why you chose your programmes, and how you will contribute to sustainable development (follow the current SI template questions).
steps.limit: Check the current guidance (set in SI's template).

steps.title: Get two reference letters
steps.why: References confirm your leadership and professional ability.
do: Ask a work supervisor who saw you lead, and a second professional or academic referee.
Send them SI's reference template if one is provided, your CV, and points about your leadership.
Ask for signed letters on letterhead by a date two weeks before the SI window closes.
Collect the PDFs to upload yourself (check the current call for the method).
tips: Referees should give examples of your leadership, not general praise.
avoid: Two academic referees who never saw you at work.
check: I have two signed letters in PDF.

steps.title: Submit in the SI portal
steps.why: The window is short and the system may be busy near the end.
do: When SI opens, register on the SI application portal using the link on the SI page.
Enter your universityadmissions.se application number exactly.
Upload passport, CV, motivation letter, proof of work and leadership, and references.
Check each file opens correctly, then submit.
Save the confirmation email.
tips: Submit at least two days before the close (last cycle closed at 14:59 CET).
check: I have a submission confirmation from SI.

links.t: Watch: SI Scholarship in Sweden| Required Documents| Answering Question on Studies in Sweden | Key insights (Atinuke Ashabi)

steps.title: Check admission results
steps.why: You must be admitted to an eligible programme for SI to award you.
do: Log in to universityadmissions.se when results are published (around late March 2027).
Accept your admission offer by the deadline if required.
If you are on a reserve list, check what SI requires by its stated date.
tips: Last cycle, about a third of SI applicants were not admitted to an eligible programme in time.
check: I am admitted to at least one SI-eligible programme.

steps.title: Get your SI result and plan travel
steps.why: Visa (residence permit) processing for Sweden can take weeks.
do: Watch for SI's decision email in April 2027.
Accept the scholarship and follow SI's instructions.
Apply for the Swedish residence permit for studies with your admission and award letters.
If unsuccessful, keep your documents and improve your leadership evidence for next year.
tips: Join SI's pre-arrival activities for the Global Professionals network.
avoid: Booking flights before the residence permit is granted.
check: I have accepted the award and applied for the residence permit.

faq.q: Do I apply to SI first or the university first?
faq.a: University first (by 15 January 2027), then SI in February.

faq.q: Does NYSC count toward the 3,000 hours?
faq.a: Not confirmed. Check SI's FAQ on calculating hours, or ask SI.
Leadership can come from work or civil society, but the 3,000 hours must be paid work.
Full tuition, SEK 12,000 per month, a travel grant and insurance.
For 2025/26, SI received 8,580 applications and awarded 351 Global Professionals scholarships.
